title: PricingContent
description: Pricing content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to four plans, each with a name, the price as it is shown, a line, an optional badge (the highlighted plan) and an action. One object is valid in every pricing layout (cards in two or three columns, rows).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

plans.description: the plans, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

price.description: the price as it is shown ($12 / month)

description.description: one line about the plan; empty: none

badge.description: a short pill on the highlighted plan; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
